decision_units.goal: Harden V1 and V2 regression and coverage time budgets for the verified Windows runtime without weakening checks or thresholds.
planned_actions: Increment every active Policy document from 2.1.0 to 2.2.0 for the semantic time-budget change while leaving historical task and acceptance evidence untouched.
Raise V1 and V2 regression_tests from 600 to 900 seconds and coverage_xml from 600 to 1200 seconds without changing commands, parsers, required flags, or thresholds.
Raise the GitHub quality job bound from 35 to 90 minutes so it exceeds the 68.5-minute legal V2 per-check budget plus setup and Gate variance.
Add exact raw-Policy, parsed-plan, and workflow contract assertions and update current operator documentation and Unreleased notes.

Update only the Phase 02 self-hosting acceptance test to assert that TASK-0025's retained Policy 2.1.0 classification is historical and fails closed under active Policy 2.2.0, without modifying any TASK-0025 artifact.

Preserve checkout of the exact pull-request head SHA, then attach that same commit to github.head_ref before formal verification with fail-closed pre/post branch and SHA assertions; do not weaken the runtime branch binding.

Bind TMPDIR to runner.temp only for the formal Verify and Gate step and derive the run directory beneath it, without changing verifier code or weakening strict descendant and evidence-output containment checks.

Make the clean-checkout E2E installer use the active interpreter's base Python pip when a uv-created environment has no pip, without widening the verification runner environment or depending on uv in PATH.

Make the V0/V1 evidence reproduction integration test use its existing controlled full-category plan so it tests evidence identities, replay and Gate without a recursive environment-sensitive real Policy execution.
